overview_description.description:
Behavox is an enterprise platform that unifies all types of data into a single data lake, allowing users to query the data and apply machine learning to identify capital markets misconduct and insider threats.

Separate Behavox installations form the network defence that aggregates misconduct detection algorithms. The network then uses machine learning and AI to optimise detection algorithms and suggest new ones. This innovation enables the “brains” to the system to continuously improve and evolve.

Complex, high-load and sophisticated engineering is at the core of all the products that Behavox develops to enable deployment at the largest institutions in financial services. They are taking cutting-edge academic research and applying it to enterprise problems that require complex backend engineering with large-scale production footprint.

product.name: Behavox Quantum
product.description: A communications surveillance platform for monitoring voice, text, visual content, and AI-generated records across workplace channels and languages to identify compliance and conduct risks.

product.name: Behavox Polaris
product.description: An AI-enabled trade-surveillance platform that monitors trading activity across asset classes, maps detection scenarios to regulations, and supports investigation and trade reconstruction.

product.name: Behavox Intelligent Archive
product.description: A regulatory archive for storing, searching, reconstructing, and producing communications and trade records for compliance and supervisory purposes.

product.name: Behavox Atlas
product.description: A control-room platform for managing restrictions, trade-floor decisions, approvals, and the evidence associated with preventive compliance controls.

product.name: Behavox Compass
product.description: A conflict-of-interest and personal-account-dealing platform for administering disclosures, restrictions, pre-clearance, and related compliance workflows.

product.name: Behavox Pathfinder
product.description: A regulatory-change management and policy platform that converts regulatory updates into approved, acknowledged, and auditable policy changes.
